title_original: Announcing Recipients of Matca Creation Grant 2025

blocks.text: The second round of the Matca Creation Grant supports the production of one photography exhibition and one series of texts, addressing the ongoing lack of sustained support for the professional development of photography practitioners. The exhibition grant is open to Vietnamese nationals residing in Vietnam, while the writing grant welcomes applicants of all nationalities.

We would like to thank everyone who took the time to apply to our open call. After a thorough review process conducted in collaboration with our guest mentors, we are pleased to announce the recipients: Nguyễn Ngọc Hải (Đà Nẵng) for the Exhibition category, and TN Đan (Singapore / HCMC) for the Writing category.
Each recipient will receive 10,000,000 VND to realize their proposals, along with artistic and logistical support from Matca and guest mentors Trương Quế Chi and Zhuang Wubin.
Nguyễn Ngọc Hải (Đà Nẵng) – Recipient of the Exhibition category

Nguyễn Ngọc Hải began shooting film photography in 2018. He currently works as a freelance wedding photographer and occasionally as a BTS photographer for independent films. His personal projects are centered on people from his everyday life, as a means of expressing how he sees and relates to the world. He is largely self-taught, having learned photography through practical experience and short workshops.
Hải will receive 10,000,000 VND and mentorship from artist, curator Trương Quế Chi to realize a solo exhibition at Matca Space for Photography.
TN Đan (Singapore / HCMC) – Recipient of the Writing category

Based in Singapore, TN Đan writes about the visual cultures of Southeast Asia and its representations. His work has appeared in Art&Market, SGIFF, PR&TA, and Matca. He co-runs Monsoon Review, an online site dedicated to examining contemporary and historical production of cultures in Southeast Asia and beyond.
Đan will receive 10,000,000 VND and mentorship from writer, researcher Zhuang Wubin to realize a series of texts in English and Vietnamese.

The Matca Creation Grant is an initiative by Matca that supports photography projects from Vietnam’s local community. The grant provides cash funding, as well as artistic and logistical support, for proposals that involve image-making, writing, and exhibiting photography.
